# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 39 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** God Commands Michael to Guard Adam

---

**39:1** God commanded Michael: 'Guard the body of Adam until the day of the resurrection.'

**39:2** Michael said: 'Lord, your will be done. I will guard him as you command.'

**39:3** Michael placed Adam's body in a place of honor and set angelic guards over it.

---
